headline: Wells Fargo Launches Tokenized Deposits on a Dual Track — and the Gap Between the Two Halves Reveals the Real Stakes
summary: Wells Fargo announced a proprietary tokenized deposit platform on August 4, 2026, scheduled for a Fall 2026 launch for select corporate and commercial clients. The initial capability: USD-GBP cross-border payments that settle around the clock. But the standalone product is only half the story.
